title: SSU detains suspect accused of guiding Russian strikes on defense plants and military units in Khmelnytskyi region
summary: Counterintelligence officers of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) have detained a man in the Khmelnytskyi region who is suspected of providing Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) with the coordinates of defense and civilian facilities for a new series of missile and drone attacks on the western region.

title: Three injured, homes damaged in Russian drone strike on Kharkiv
summary: Three people were injured and 10 residential buildings were damaged in a Russian drone strike on Kharkiv.

title: EU and Canada reaffirm continued support for Ukraine
summary: The European Union and Canada have pledged to continue stepping up pressure on Russia and supporting Ukraine, including with reforms and Euro-Atlantic integration.

title: Zelensky: 500 Patriot interceptors could provide Ukraine with strong defense this winter
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky called the U.S. State Department’s decision to authorize Ukraine to purchase interceptors for countering Russian ballistic missiles for Patriot systems a strong one.

title: Merz announces Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has invited members of the Coalition of the Willing to a meeting in Berlin in November to coordinate further support for Ukraine.

title: Putin's demands on NATO show he is out of touch with reality – Polish expert
summary: Putin's new demands that NATO reduce its presence on the eastern flank repeat proposals the Kremlin leader made back in December 2021 and which the Alliance rejected at the time. Their reiteration today shows that Putin is out of touch with reality.

title: Kyiv City Military Administration says first mobile shelters will be installed in capital by year-end
summary: The first mobile civil defense shelters in the capital could be installed using budget funds by the end of the year.

title: Ukrainian forces hit over 1,000 Russian boats with drones this year
summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces have destroyed or disabled 1,039 Russian military boats and vessels using unmanned aerial vehicles since the beginning of 2026.

title: Russian aggression destroys 25% of Ukraine’s biodiversity, forces 10 national parks to cease operations
summary: At the 17th Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17), being held in Yerevan, Armenia, the Ukrainian delegation highlighted the large-scale impact of Russia’s armed aggression on Ukraine’s natural environment.

title: Humanitarian hub set up to receive participants in mission to temporarily occupied Oleshky
summary: A humanitarian hub has been set up at the meeting point for the Ukrainian team that carried out a humanitarian mission to the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky.

title: Ukrainian forces strike rocket fuel plant in Russia's Rostov region
summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces have used attack drones and Neptune coastal missile systems to strike a rocket fuel production plant in Russia's Rostov region.

title: Energy equipment seriously damaged in Russian attacks in Dnipropetrovsk region
summary: Energy equipment was seriously damaged in overnight Russian attacks in the Dnipropetrovsk region, leaving parts of Dnipro and Kamianske without electricity.

title: Zelensky: Nearly 300,000 households left without power after Russian strikes on Dnipropetrovsk, Kyiv regions
summary: Russian strikes on energy facilities on October 30 caused serious power supply problems in several regions.

title: Explosions reported in Russia's Ufa, oil refinery unit on fire – media
summary: Residents of Ufa, the capital of Russia's Bashkortostan Republic, reported explosions and columns of smoke rising over an industrial area in the northern part of the city in the early hours of Saturday.

title: Khmara, Drapatyi discuss key security risks, planning of combat operations
summary: Ukraine's Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and Commander-in-Chief of the Ukrainian Armed Forces Mykhailo Drapatyi held a joint meeting to discuss key security risks and the planning of combat operations.

title: Russian forces strike Sumy with drones, hits reported in industrial zone
summary: Russian forces attacked civilian infrastructure in Sumy with drones on Saturday morning, with several hits reported in an industrial zone.

title: Russian forces launch double strike on Kharkiv with Banderol missiles
summary: Russian forces have struck two districts of Kharkiv with Banderol missiles.

title: Evacuated residents of Oleshky to reach Ukrainian-controlled territory within hours – Arakhamia
summary: The evacuated residents of Oleshky will be on Ukrainian territory within a few hours.

title: Japan’s FM urges Russia to release journalist detained on Sakhalin
summary: Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi on Friday urged Moscow to immediately release a Japanese journalist detained on suspicion of espionage and take steps to achieve a just and lasting peace in Ukraine during a meeting with his Russian counterpart, Sergey Lavrov.

title: Russian forces using mercenaries form Africa and Asia in assaults on Huliaipole front – military
summary: Russian forces are deploying recruited mercenaries from African and Asian countries in assaults on the Huliaipole sector of the front line.

title: One killed, 12 injured as Russian forces attack Sumy region
summary: One woman, aged 43, was killed and 12 people were injured in Russian attacks in the Sumy region over the past day.

title: War update: 173 clashes on front line over past day, fiercest fighting in Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka sectors
summary: A total of 173 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the front line on October 30.

title: Air defenses down 105 out of 134 Russian drones launched at Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 105 out of the 134 drones launched by Russian invading forces against Ukraine since the evening of October 30.

title: Casualties reported as Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region overnight
summary: Russian forces attacked five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 20 times with drones overnight. One person was killed and two others were injured.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,670 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 31, 2026, amount to approximately 1,588,170 personnel, including 1,670 over the past 24 hours.

title: Canada to provide €500 million to support Ukraine
summary: Canada will contribute to the Ukraine Support Loan provided by the EU for 2026–2027 and will allocate €500 million.
